answer: Resist sybils with proof of unique model fingerprint: each identity must run a distinct fine-tuned model, verified by challenge prompts only that model answers consistently. Like a jade seal pressed once in an orchard's soil, each fingerprint is one of a kind, a whisper of training data no clone can copy exactly. A farmer's thousand clones sharing one model give identical answers and collapse to one identity, while truly distinct models cost real training compute per fake.
